mode_selection: nearest native CAMB q for each target, require nine distinct indices; q is in 1/Mpc and k_h=q/h

transformation.class: D_m=delta_m+3 a H theta_m/k^2 for stable pressureless matter
transformation.camb_manual: delta_m=(rho_c Delta_c+rho_b Delta_b)/(rho_c+rho_b), theta_m=k(rho_c v_c+rho_b v_b)/(rho_c+rho_b)
transformation.independent_symbolic: make_frame_invariant(delta_m, frame=v_m) on the same get_results object
transformation.excluded: no photon, massless-neutrino or total-heat-flux velocity in the matter-comoving frame; massive neutrinos are zero in these inputs

internal_acceptance.meaning: These thresholds test interface normalization and the explicit mapping only, not physical cross-code accuracy.

class_comparison.interpolation: signed linear d_m in natural log k at the nine actual CAMB k values; no extrapolation or smoothing
class_comparison.report: signed values, fractional differences, squared-transfer ratios and same-sign flags
class_comparison.acceptance: none; sparse cross-code outcomes are diagnostics and cannot prove whole-spectrum convergence

output_rule: Write new gauge-transform artifacts without modifying previous spectra, transfer, interpolation or CLASS outputs.
boundaries: No physical parameter changes and no nonzero CDM placeholder in the zero model.
Sparse validation does not complete a full-spectrum gauge-transformed band-power analysis.
Recombination, perturbation implementation, sampling and interpolation systematics remain separate.
No observational likelihood, covariance, joint BBN, nonlinear calculation, or model-family exclusion.
